angles.contentStyle: cinematic minute-by-minute documentary retelling of a single Titanic or great maritime disaster — one ship, one night, one decision at a time. Chapters follow real chronology: the build-up, the fatal moment, the chaos, the survivors, the aftermath. Calm, measured, haunting delivery grounded in the documented record. Every claim verifiable; never invent dialogue or numbers. End on the detail that stays with the viewer.

angles.contentStyle: primary-source historical deep dive — one obscure but thoroughly documented historical episode, framed around what the original records, witnesses, and documents actually said. Archival, specific, restrained: quote what the record states, name the year of the record, walk through what was found and what the documents left unresolved. The framing is always 'here is what the record actually says', never speculation.
